basics.description: Deploys vaultgate, a remote MCP server for Bitwarden with its own OAuth 2.1 authorization server, as an Azure Container App. Your Bitwarden credentials can go straight into a Key Vault now (the app reads them through a managed identity) or be entered on the account page after the first sign-in.

basics.name: name
basics.label: Name
basics.toolTip: Base name for every resource and the Container App itself: 3 to 20 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

constraints.validationMessage: 3 to 20 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen.

elements.name: bwClientId
elements.label: API key client id
elements.toolTip: Optional. Personal API key client id from Bitwarden Settings > Security > Keys; it starts with user. Leave all three Bitwarden fields empty to connect the vault from the account page after the first sign-in.

constraints.validationMessage: Empty, or user. followed by a UUID.

elements.name: bwClientSecret
elements.toolTip: Optional. Personal API key client secret from the same Bitwarden page.

constraints.validationMessage: Empty, or at least 16 characters without whitespace.

elements.name: bwPassword
elements.toolTip: Optional. Your Bitwarden master password. It is written to Key Vault only; the Container App receives it through a secret reference.

constraints.validationMessage: Empty, or at least 12 characters (Bitwarden's minimum).

elements.name: secretKey
elements.toolTip: VAULTGATE_SECRET_KEY: at least 32 bytes as base64 (openssl rand -base64 32) or 64 hex characters. Leave empty to generate one; retrieve it from Key Vault afterwards and back it up with the database.

constraints.validationMessage: Empty, or at least 32 bytes as base64 (43+ characters) or hex (64+ characters).

elements.name: imageTag
elements.label: Image tag
elements.toolTip: Tag of ghcr.io/adamrowles1996/vaultgate to run. Pin a release such as 1.0.0 for production.

constraints.validationMessage: A container image tag: up to 128 letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.

elements.name: bitwardenServer
elements.label: Bitwarden server (optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave empty for bitwarden.com. Enter bitwarden.eu, or the https:// URL of a self-hosted Bitwarden server or Vaultwarden.

constraints.validationMessage: Empty, bitwarden.eu, or an https:// URL.

elements.name: publicUrl
elements.label: Custom public URL (optional)
elements.toolTip: Set this only once you bind a custom domain to the app (see the README): the https:// origin, for example https://vault.example.com. Otherwise the generated azurecontainerapps.io host is used.

constraints.validationMessage: Empty, or an https:// origin without a path.

elements.name: enableWriteScope
elements.label: Allow clients to request the vault:write scope
elements.toolTip: Off by default: agents may only read. Turn on to let clients request vault:write; each client still has to be granted it at authorization time.

elements.name: logLevel
elements.label: Log level
elements.toolTip: VAULTGATE_LOG_LEVEL. Logs are JSON lines in the Log Analytics workspace.
